content.title: Everything To Know About The Masked Singer Season 14 Semi-Finals, Including Galaxy Girl's Song (SPOILERS)
content.text: Published Mar 23, 2026, 3:48 PM EDT Lorianne Palinkas has been a reality television writer for Screen Rant for four years. After teaching middle school English for twenty years, she knows a thing or two about high drama, complicated alliances, and even singing competitions. Growing up in New York City gave her a solid foundation in the arts and culture. WARNING! THIS ARTICLE CONTAINS MAJOR SPOILERS ABOUT THE MASKED SINGER SEASON 14!On March 25, 2026, The Masked Singer season 14 will present its semi-finals episode, in which the final five mystery celebrities will compete for their spots in the finale. The Masked Singer season 14 welcomed back host Nick Cannon, along with panelists Robin Thicke, Jenny McCarthy-Wahlberg, Ken Jeong, and Rita Ora. The Masked Singer season 14 has unmasked 13 of its 18 amazing celebrity contestants so far, including David Ortiz (Googly Eyes), Todd and Julie Chrisley (Croissants), Tiffany Haddish (Le Who Who), Tone Lōc (Handyman), Taraji P. Henson (Scarab), Claudia Oshry (Queen Corgi), Teddi Mellencamp (Calla Lily), Billy Ray Cyrus (Owl), Heidi Montag (Snow Cone), Jack Wagner (Eggplant), Alexi Lalas (High Voltage), Judge Greg Mathis (14 Karat Carrot), and Evan Ross (Stingray). Who Is Performing During The Masked Singer Season 14 Semi-Finals? The Masked Singer season 14 semi-finalists are Cat Witch, Crane, Galaxy Girl, Pangolin, and Pugcasso. The episode doesn't have a theme. Crane, Pangolin, and Pugcasso advanced during Care Bears Night, while Cat Witch and Galaxy Girl moved on during Star Trek Night. Cat Witch, Galaxy Girl, and Pugcasso all made their Masked Singer season 14 debuts on Premiere Night, but Crane and Pangolin were Wild Card contestants. Crane first appeared during week 3 on Clueless Night, while Pangolin joined the competition during week 5 on Red, White & Clue Night. In an Instagram post, The Masked Singer highlighted the fact that the semi-finals contestants consist of four women and one man. What Song Is Galaxy Girl Singing In The Masked Singer Season 14 Semi-Finals? Credit: Michael Becker/FOX How Many Contestants Will Advance To The Masked Singer Season 14 Finale? According to a FOX press release shared by The Futon Critic, four contestants will advance to the Masked Singer season 14 finale. This means that one of the semi-finalists will be eliminated and unmasked during the semi-finals episode. On April 1, the final four will compete in the two-hour finale for the Golden Mask Trophy. The Masked Singer season 14 has been one of the most phenomenal in the show's history. Every contestant could at least carry a tune, and most of them have extraordinary voices that have made it nearly impossible to say goodbye to contestants every week. Cat Witch, Crane, Galaxy Girl, Pangolin, and Pugcasso have been wowing everyone with their incredible performances since they each debuted on the show. The Masked Singer season 14 semi-finals episode is certain to be the most thrilling yet. The Masked Singer airs Wednesdays at 8 p.m. ET on FOX. Sources: The Masked Singer/Instagram, The Futon Critic
